notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI) and make REST calls to PUBLIC_API (FastAPI); Provider push sends provider events to WEBHOOK (Flask); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).

CHAT (FastAPI) reads + writes PostgreSQL, enqueues SQS tasks and makes API calls to LLM providers; INTERACTION (Flask) long-polls SQS, reads + writes PostgreSQL, enqueues SQS tasks, makes API calls to CRM + workspace APIs and makes API calls to LLM providers; PUBLIC_API (FastAPI) reads + writes PostgreSQL; WEBHOOK (Flask) reads PostgreSQL and makes API calls to CRM + workspace APIs.
Temporal workflows read + write PostgreSQL.

AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers, SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers and OUTREACH · WORKFLOWSCHEDULER workers long-poll SQS; AGENT · REALTIMEAGENT · EXTRACTIONAGENT · ASYNC_AGENT workers also read PostgreSQL and make API calls to LLM providers; SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers also read + write PostgreSQL and make API calls to CRM + workspace APIs; and also SOR · BATCH · BACKFILL · INTEGRATION workers enqueue follow-up SQS tasks.
